requirements.text: The system shall provide a graphical color chooser tool driven by a pointing device.
The system shall provide a color translator to convert paint numbers from an old scheme to a new scheme.
The system shall provide a tool to find a specified number of colors closest to a given paint number and collection.
The system shall provide a color search engine to locate colors across collections based on name, number, or color value.
The system shall provide a session-persistent user color palette to store recent searches and uploaded images.
The system shall provide an administrative interface to add, update, and delete paint information and manage user accounts.
The system shall support a color sample matcher to allow users to upload images for color matching.
The system shall implement a theme and styling mechanism for website integration.
The system shall provide an administrative access control model with three levels of permissions.
The system shall process color search queries in sub-second time on the server.
The system shall display the server-side processing time for each request to the user.
The system shall be fully functional using only a keyboard input device.
The system shall provide a task-pane in all workflows for on-line help and navigation.
The system shall secure administrative access and permissions using username and pass phrase authentication.
The system shall automatically remove user palette data from the server after 30 days.
The server shall support at least 50 concurrent users with a 1GHz processor and 512 MB of system memory.
The system shall be compatible with Internet Explorer 4.01, Netscape 6.0, or Mozilla 1.0 or later.
The system shall provide error reporting that attempts automatic recovery without interrupting the user experience.
